name: promotion
note: The promotion rule as a goal (Game.promotes): a pawn of ours reaching its last rank is replaced by a queen, so its stake is the material valuation's worth of the queen less the pawn's (8); the queen is the only unit the agenda places (underpromotion is never asked: a choice of ours, HAND); a pawn within three pushes is a root (near, 52.6: the mate and material stakes dominate farther pawns; a far passer the tempo arithmetic calls unstoppable is one too), cited by no Lean theorem as a goal.
